  "reasons": [
    "Average profit = (Rs 30,000 + Rs 36,000 + Rs 42,000) / 3 = Rs 1,08,000 / 3 = Rs 36,000.",
    "Value of Goodwill = Average Profit × Number of years' purchase = Rs 36,000 × 4 = Rs 1,44,000."
  ],
  "syllabus_chapter": "Goodwill Valuation",
  "syllabus_topic": "Methods of valuation: Average profit method",
  "syllabus_entitlement": true,
  "presentation_ready": true,
  "question_type_match": true,
  "principle_applicability": "excerpt_required",
  "decisive_principle_in_excerpts": true,
  "answer_conditions": [
    {
      "condition": "Past three years profits are Rs 30,000, Rs 36,000, and Rs 42,000.",
      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "condition": "Number of years' purchase is 4.",
      "status": "explicit",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "condition": "Goodwill is calculated as Average Profit multiplied by the number of years' purchase.",
      "status": "convention",
      "alters_key_if_changed": true,
      "convention_evidence_ids": ["E1.1"]
    }
  ],
  "option_challenges": [
    {
      "option": "B",
      "strongest_reading": "Goodwill equals the simple average profit of the three past years without multiplying by the number of years' purchase.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "strongest_reading": "Goodwill equals the aggregate three-year profits rather than being calculated from the average and purchase years multiplier.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "strongest_reading": "Goodwill equals the total profits of the three years multiplied by 4 years' purchase instead of using the average.",
      "correct_under_reading": false,
      "reading_status": "contradicts_stem",
      "convention_evidence_ids": []
    }
  ],

  "option_resolution": [
    {
      "option": "A",
      "status": "supported",
      "false_part": "",
      "premise_source": "arithmetic",
      "evidence_id": "",
      "premise_quote": "The profits of a firm for the last three years were Rs 30,000, Rs 36,000 and Rs 42,000. Goodwill is to be valued at 4 years' purchase of the average profits of these three years.",
      "reason": "Average profit is Rs 36,000; multiplied by 4 years' purchase gives Rs 1,44,000."
    },
    {
      "option": "B",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Rs 36,000",
      "premise_source": "arithmetic",
      "evidence_id": "",
      "premise_quote": "Goodwill is to be valued at 4 years' purchase of the average profits of these three years.",
      "reason": "Rs 36,000 is merely the average profit before multiplying by 4 years' purchase."
    },
    {
      "option": "C",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Rs 1,08,000",
      "premise_source": "arithmetic",
      "evidence_id": "",
      "premise_quote": "Goodwill is to be valued at 4 years' purchase of the average profits of these three years.",
      "reason": "Rs 1,08,000 is the total profit of three years, not the goodwill."
    },
    {
      "option": "D",
      "status": "contradicted",
      "false_part": "Rs 4,32,000",
      "premise_source": "arithmetic",
      "evidence_id": "",
      "premise_quote": "Goodwill is to be valued at 4 years' purchase of the average profits of these three years.",
      "reason": "Rs 4,32,000 is total profit multiplied by 4, failing to take the average."
    }
  ]
